prompt:
A line-art multi-panel storyboard of one continuous scene of a live-action short drama: one image divided into a grid of 3 columns and 3 rows of equal 9:16 panels, 9 panels read from left to right and top to bottom; cells after the last panel stay plain white. Every panel is a colouring-book drawing: contours only, in one thin uniform black line on white, most of the panel left white. Draw only the people and the few large shapes of the place (walls, doors, windows, a bed, a car). People are simple storyboard figures: hair is one smooth outline of its shape, like a cap, empty inside, with no strands, curls or waves; a face has one short line each for the eyes, brows, nose and mouth, and no stubble, wrinkles or jaw lines; a fence is its posts and top rail, a tree its outline. No texture, mesh, bricks, leaves or fabric folds; no shading, grey or solid black: dark hair, clothes and cars are outlines left white inside. Thin black panel borders, plain white gutters. Location: INT. SU YAQING'S LIVING ROOM, Day, soft daylight through sheer curtains.
Image 1: the character sheet of Su Yaqing (27)
Image 2: the character sheet of Lin Qingyu (21), look S0
Image 3: the location INT. SU YAQING'S LIVING ROOM, the front view, the establishing view, facing the back wall, with no people
Image 4: the location INT. SU YAQING'S LIVING ROOM, the back view, turned 180 degrees, facing the front wall, with the left wall at its right edge, with no people
Image 5: the location INT. SU YAQING'S LIVING ROOM, the left-side view, facing the left wall, with the back wall at its right edge, with no people
Image 6: the location INT. SU YAQING'S LIVING ROOM, the right-side view, facing the right wall, with the back wall at its left edge, with no people
Image 7: the location INT. SU YAQING'S LIVING ROOM, the floor plan seen from above: its top edge is the back wall, its bottom edge the front wall behind the front view's camera, and its left and right edges the left and right walls, with no people
Image 8: the blocking reference of this segment, the same place with its people in their places at the start; use it only for where each person is and which way they face, and keep each person on that seat or spot, on the same side of the room, in every panel until a shot moves them; do not copy its colours or light
Image 9: the prop phone; use only structure, material, and color
Image 10: the prop glass; use only structure, material, and color
Draw each character so they can be told apart as in their reference image, by the shape of the hairstyle, the build and the outfit in outline only; never copy the photograph's detail. Use the character sheets only for the characters, not for their layout, white background or multiple views. Use the location images only for the layout of the space and the place of its furniture and props, drawn in outline. There is only one of each vehicle, piece of furniture and prop that the location shows, defined by the location images, throughout all panels; when a panel shows only part of one, such as a car's hood, it is that same object, and no second one appears. Each panel shows only the characters it names, and nobody appears twice in one panel.
At the start: Su Yaqing sits on the cream bouclé sofa in the middle of the room, its back to the curtained windows, facing the phone propped on the tablet stand on the round travertine coffee table, which also holds flowers. The brass floor lamp stands beside the sofa. The brass-framed kitchen doorway on the right wall is empty.
Panel 1: Medium shot, slow push in, low angle, from beside the coffee table facing the sofa. Su Yaqing sits forward on the edge of the sofa toward the phone on the stand, her eyes lighting up with an idea.
Panel 2: Close-up, locked-off camera, eye level, from the coffee table side. Su Yaqing gives a sly matchmaker's grin and counts the points off on her fingers beside her face.
Panel 3: Medium close-up, locked-off camera, eye level, from the TV wall side facing the sofa. Su Yaqing pouts at the phone on the stand.
Panel 4: Medium shot, tilt up following the phone, high angle, over the travertine coffee table. Su Yaqing leans in and lifts the phone off the tablet stand into both hands.
Panel 5: Close-up, locked-off camera, eye level, from the coffee table side. Su Yaqing makes a mock-sulky face at the phone screen.
Panel 6: Medium shot, slow push in, low angle, from beside the coffee table. Su Yaqing's teasing smile fades. She nods slowly and settles back into the cushions with a sympathetic frown.
Panel 7: Medium shot, locked-off camera, eye level, from the TV wall facing the sofa. Su Yaqing looks up and smiles warmly at the phone, holding it in both hands.
Panel 8: Wide shot, locked-off camera, eye level, from the TV wall facing the sofa and the kitchen doorway on the right wall. Lin Qingyu steps out of the kitchen into the brass-framed doorway on the right wall, holding a glass of water. Su Yaqing on the sofa keeps smiling at her phone without seeing him.
Panel 9: Medium close-up, clean single, slow push in, low angle, from the TV wall side facing the kitchen doorway. Only Lin Qingyu, framed on the face and shoulders. He leans against the brass doorframe, sips from the glass and gives a quiet, knowing smile toward the sofa.
Keep the characters, the number and position of every vehicle, piece of furniture and prop, and the location's spatial orientation consistent across all panels.
No text, letters, numbers, captions, speech bubbles, panel labels or watermark anywhere in the image; no photographic rendering.
